summary: Government announces a police-led national competence centre against illegal drone flying at the police emergency response centre, Taraldrud, plus approx NOK 30 million for counter-drone equipment.
quote: Dronesenteret skal etableres ved politiets beredskapssenter på Taraldrud i Nordre Follo, og skal være en felles arena for kunnskapsdeling, rådgivning og informasjon om risikoreduserende tiltak knyttet til ulovlig droneflyging.
notes: Primary release on regjeringen.no (id3176870, id3023366) and politiet.no 2025-12-17 returned 403 / JS-only; not opened. Framed around the security situation, not criminal use.

summary: Correctional Service Directorate (KDI) confirms it rents a DJI drone-detection system from Avinor (NOK 540,000/year) at one prison and tests Kongsberg equipment at another; prisons not named. KDI says drone activity has been registered at Norwegian units, scale not yet large.
quote: Det er registrert aktivitet ved og over enheter i Norge.
notes: Statement by KDI assistant director Jan-Erik Sandlie by e-mail to Dagbladet. Only official qualitative statement found on drone activity at Norwegian prisons; no count published.

summary: Luftfartstilsynet imposes permanent no-fly zones (926 m radius, incl. drones) over eight high-security prisons incl. Halden, at KDI's request, to prevent smuggling and surveillance of escape routes.
quote: Luftfartstilsynet har innført flyforbud over fengsler med høyt sikkerhetsnivå for å hindre smugling eller overvåking av mulige fluktruter.
notes: Predates the 2021 window; kept as the standing legal baseline still in force.

summary: Polisregion Syd pilot of remotely operated 'drone as first responder' units on Malmö rooftops since spring 2024; extended to Helsingborg, to be introduced in more police regions in 2026. Transportstyrelsen restriction areas protect the police drones.
quote: I ett nationellt pilotprojekt som testas i Malmö sedan våren 2024, kan drönare som är placerade på strategiskt belägna hustak i staden aktiveras och styras från polisens kamerabevakningscentral.
notes: Police use of drones (counter side), not criminal use. Press release dated February 2026 per URL path.

summary: Sveriges Radio (Kaliber) review: Swedish police have counter-drone equipment but not nationwide; protective guards may not use jammers. Police Region Väst drone lead describes criminal prison drops elsewhere in Europe.
quote: Polisen har utrustning mot drönare, men den finns inte tillgänglig i hela landet.
notes: Page shows 'Publicerad 14 apr' without a year; year 2026 inferred, not seen on page. No Swedish incident is named.

summary: SVT: Polismyndigheten drone flight hours rose about 600 percent over six years (NOA UAS flight chief).
quote: På sex år har det skett en dramatisk ökning – där antalet flygtimmar ökat med omkring 600 procent.
notes: Published 2024-05-13, updated 2025-10-10. Police use, counter side.

summary: Riksdag interpellation 2025/26:302 asks the government to let Stockholm police use remotely operated drones as in Malmö; Bromma control zone restricts flights above 50 m.
quote: Vilka konkreta åtgärder avser ministern, regeringen och Justitiedepartementet att vidta för att säkerställa att Polismyndigheten ges förutsättningar att använda fjärrstyrda drönare i Stockholms luftrum på samma sätt som i Malmö?
notes: Exact filing date not seen on fetched page (riksmöte 2025/26).

summary: National Police (Rigspolitiet) report buying thermal binoculars, drone detection/identification/tracking equipment and basic takedown equipment for all police districts, and a cross-district drone network, after the September 2025 airport drone reports. Driven by state/hybrid incidents, not criminal use.
quote: Derudover har Rigspolitiet indkøbt andet udstyr til at detektere, identificere og spore droner. Samlet skal udstyret bidrage til, at politiet i højere grad kan kvalificere anmeldelser og skelne mellem det, der er ikke er mistænkeligt, det der er ulovligt, og det der potentielt udgør en udfordring i politimæssig sammenhæng. Herudover har Rigspolitiet indkøbt basalt nedtagningsudstyr.
quote_translation: In addition, the National Police has bought other equipment to detect, identify and track drones. Together the equipment should help police better qualify reports and distinguish what is not suspicious, what is illegal and what is potentially a policing challenge. The National Police has also bought basic takedown equipment.

summary: Central Finland Police (Sisä-Suomen poliisi) used a drone to locate a person wanted to serve a ~1.5-year prison sentence, hiding in tall grass in western Tampere. Police use of drones, not a criminal drone event.
quote: Sisä-Suomen poliisi on löytänyt puoli vuotta pakoilleen etsintäkuulutetun henkilön Tampereella droonin avulla.
notes: Yle page dated 2.7. without year; year 2026 inferred from article ID sequence (after 74-20197577 of 2025-12-04) and poliisi.fi listing. Event 'keskiviikkona' = Wednesday 2026-07-01.
quote_translation: Central Finland Police have found, with the help of a drone, a wanted person who had been evading for half a year in Tampere.

summary: GBP 900,000 new investment in counter-drone operations at prisons; police-led counter-drone operations at HMPs Manchester and Wandsworth led to nine arrests
quote: The move is backed by a new investment of £900,000

summary: Scottish Prison Service piloting AI drone detection (Dedrone pilot ended); exploring other technologies
quote: SPS is currently exploring other software and technologies that are on the market.

summary: Memorandum of Understanding between Irish Prison Service and An Garda Síochána; Garda Operation Throwover targets contraband entering prisons
quote: This week, the Irish Prison Service and An Garda Síochána signed a Memorandum of Understanding to formalise a framework for interagency cooperation.

summary: €5m allocated in 2025 capital budget for prison security; fire-resistant netting being rolled out
quote: €5m has been allocated in the 2025 Capital budget for prison security.

summary: New Garda drone unit for day-to-day policing including planned operations against criminal gangs
quote: An Garda Síochána are set to deploy drones for day-to-day policing after the creation of a new drone unit.

summary: Justice ministry: 58 prisons already equipped with anti-drone devices, 19 more to be deployed before end of Q1 2026.
quote: 58 établissements pénitentiaires sont déjà équipés de dispositifs anti-drones et 19 nouveaux dispositifs seront déployés avant la fin du 1er trimestre 2026.
notes: Text extracted with pdftotext from the downloaded PDF; line break joined.
quote_translation: 58 prisons are already equipped with anti-drone devices and 19 new devices will be deployed before the end of Q1 2026.

summary: Ministry reply to written question 9618: 62 prisons equipped and functional in Feb 2026 of 78 devices ordered; last 16 by end 2026.
quote: En février 2026, 62 établissements sont équipés et fonctionnels sur les 78 dispositifs qui ont été commandés.
notes: Page fetched via curl; reply published JO 30 June 2026.
quote_translation: In February 2026, 62 establishments are equipped and functional out of the 78 devices ordered.

summary: Eight Bavarian prisons equipped with the mobile net-launcher 'Dropster'; JVA Amberg has a drone detection system (since August 2021) and JVA Straubing is being fitted with one.
quote: Acht Justizvollzugsanstalten sind mit dem mobilen Drohnenabwehrsystem „Dropster“ ausgestattet.
notes: Date is the answer date of Drucksache 19/9472.
quote_translation: Eight prisons are equipped with the mobile 'Dropster' drone defence system.

summary: NRW pilot project for drone detection in selected, rotating prisons running since 2025-12-04.
quote: Seit dem 4. Dezember 2025 läuft in ausgewählten und wechselnden Haftanstalten ein Pilotprojekt zur Drohnendetektion.
notes: Secondary report of a Landtag answer; primary document not located.
quote_translation: Since 4 December 2025 a drone detection pilot has been running in selected, rotating prisons.

summary: Federal Interior Minister Dobrindt commissions a new Bundespolizei unit to detect, intercept or shoot down drones, stationed at airports, in Berlin and near security-relevant sites.
quote: Eine neue Einheit, die unbemannte Luftfahrzeuge aufspüren, abfangen oder abschießen soll, hat Bundesinnenminister Alexander Dobrindt (CSU) jetzt in Dienst gestellt.
notes: Aimed at espionage, sabotage and airspace disruption, not specifically criminal groups.
quote_translation: A new unit meant to detect, intercept or shoot down unmanned aircraft has now been commissioned by Federal Interior Minister Alexander Dobrindt.

summary: Unauthorised drone flights over prisons are an administrative offence under section 21h(3) no. 3 LuftVO with a 100 m lateral exclusion zone.
quote: Unerlaubte Drohnenüberflüge über Justizvollzugsanstalten stellen nach § 21h Abs. 3 Nr. 3 Luftverkehrs-Ordnung (LuftVO) in Verbindung mit § 44 Abs. 1 Nr. 17d LuftVO und § 58 Abs. 2 Luftverkehrsgesetz (LuftVG) eine Ordnungswidrigkeit dar.
notes: Date is the Berlin Senate answer date; legal text itself not opened. 100 m zone is from drohnen.de, not this source.
quote_translation: Unauthorised drone overflights of prisons are an administrative offence under section 21h(3) no. 3 LuftVO in conjunction with section 44(1) no. 17d LuftVO and section 58(2) LuftVG.

summary: Canton Solothurn to equip the Deitingen prison (JVA Schachen) with a drone detection system costing several hundred thousand francs.
quote: Der Kanton Solothurn rüstet die Justizvollzugsanstalt (JVA) im Deitinger Schachen mit einem Drohnendetektionssystem aus.
notes: Same article reports a 2018 incident in Solothurn where an inmate received a mobile phone by drone (outside window).
quote_translation: The canton of Solothurn is equipping the Deitingen Schachen prison with a drone detection system.

summary: Statutory power for DJI to disrupt or disable drones at high-security prisons
quote: krijgt per 1 juli 2026 een wettelijke bevoegdheid om drones en andere onbemande voertuigen te verstoren of uit te schakelen
notes: Applies only to institutions with extra or extended security level; use requires a concrete threat.
source_title: Extra bevoegdheid om drones te bestrijden rondom zwaar beveiligde gevangenissen

summary: Prison administration tender for autonomous 'drone-in-a-box' perimeter monitoring, Haren prison as pilot site
quote: L'objectif est de renforcer la surveillance des abords des prisons, souvent ciblées par des largages de drogues et de téléphones.

summary: Justice Minister Verlinden starts pilot using drones to check prison walls for thrown parcels
quote: Minister Verlinden start met een proefproject om met drones de gevangenismuren te controleren.

summary: Justice minister told Chamber committee the draft new Penal Code criminalises throwing objects over a prison wall, directly or indirectly e.g. by drone
quote: Concreet wordt het direct of indirect, bijvoorbeeld met een drone, overgooien van alle soorten voorwerpen over de omheining of de muur van een gevangenis strafbaar.

summary: Council of Ministers emergency declaration to buy portable counter-UAS detection and neutralisation systems for prisons, EUR 4 million
quote: El Consejo de Ministros ha aprobado esta misma semana una declaración de emergencia para comprar “sistemas de detección, identificación, seguimiento, monitorización y neutralización portátiles de aeronaves no tripuladas UAS” para proteger el exterior de las prisiones españolas

summary: Ministry of Justice pilot of mobile-phone and drone-remote jammers at Vale de Judeus prison, to be extended to all prisons
quote: A cadeia de Vale de Judeus vai ter inibidores que vão bloquear totalmente os sinais de telemóvel e de "drones".

summary: Guardia Civil Ceuta fixed drone-detection and jamming device (Pegaso unit); SIGLO-CD national counter-drone system
quote: El dispositivo, denominado Pegaso, tiene la capacidad de detectar los drones y anular su vuelo parando el motor.

summary: Installation of mobile-phone and drone signal jammers began at Vale de Judeus prison after repeated delays
quote: Equipamentos destinados a bloquear sinais de telemóveis e drones começaram a ser instalados na prisão de Vale de Judeus, após vários atrasos causados por problemas logísticos, mau tempo e pela guerra no Médio Oriente.

summary: Catalan Department of Justice plans pilot of drone inhibitors at Brians 2 prison during 2025
quote: Per abordar aquesta situació que cada cop va a més, el Departament de Justícia prepara un pla pilot amb inhibidors de drons a la presó de Brians 2

summary: 63 anti-drone devices in service across Italian prisons (43 fixed systems at as many institutions, 20 mobile jammers); 4 more fixed systems awaiting testing.
quote: Alla data del 10 agosto 2026 risultavano complessivamente in dotazione 63 dispositivi antidrone, dei quali 43 sistemi fissi installati presso altrettanti istituti e 20 dispositivi mobili di contrasto, comunemente denominati jammer.

summary: National programme of anti-drone netting over exposed detention areas: 5 institutions equipped, 14 in planning/funding/construction, 21 in a centralised tender (as of 10 Aug 2026).
quote: Alla data del 10 agosto 2026, cinque istituti risultavano già dotati di tali schermature, quattordici erano interessati da interventi in fase di programmazione, finanziamento, affidamento o realizzazione e ulteriori ventuno erano ricompresi in una procedura di gara centralizzata.

summary: Polish Prison Service gains power to destroy, immobilise or take over drones in designated zones over prisons (aviation-law amendment adopted early 2025); Director General order issued second half of Nov 2025.
quote: Służba Więzienna dostała nowe uprawnienia do zestrzeliwania i przejmowania dronów nad więzieniami. Powstaje ogólnopolski system antydronowy.

summary: 62 French prisons equipped with operational drone detection, characterisation and neutralisation (DCND) systems as of February 2026. Government reply published 26 May 2026.
quote: En février 2026, 62 établissements sont équipés et fonctionnels

summary: Irish Prison Service spent €5 million on metallic mesh netting over outdoor areas against contraband drops (Justice Minister reply, reported by Echo).
quote: has spent €5 million on metallic mesh netting in outdoor areas to combat contraband drops.

summary: Tevkros anti-drone system (GEETHA/KETAK) used at Larissa Prison; 25 Tevkros II systems expected by the General Secretariat for Crime Policy.
quote: the General Secretariat for Crime Policy is expected to receive 25 additional “Tevkros II” anti-drone systems.

summary: Government bill submitted to Parliament to widen police powers to intervene in drones and similar unmanned vehicles (air, land, surface, underwater), by technical means, force or firearm.
quote: Poliisille aiotaan antaa nykyistä laajemmat toimivaltuudet puuttua miehittämättömien kulkuneuvojen käyttöön.
notes: Same Yle text confirms the existing standing power: 'Nyt laissa puhutaan vain miehittämättömistä ilma-aluksista, jotka poliisilla on oikeus ottaa tilapäisesti haltuun tai estää niiden käyttö teknisin laittein.' Compendium dates for that power (18 Mar 2019) and RISE detection/jamming powers (July 2019) were NOT found on any page opened; only 2018 proposals were seen (MTV 2018-06-29, Yle 2018-11-08). General counter-drone law, not specific to criminal use. MTV carries the same story (2026-09-15).
quote_translation: The police are to be given broader powers than at present to intervene in the use of unmanned vehicles.
source_title: Poliisi saa laajemmat valtuudet jahdata drooneja
